record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare SUPER_FANG: Bidoof (1 star, maxPP 90) and Bibarel (2 stars, maxPP 80), range 1, no passive. Units are bound by the queue record only.
record.summary: Single-target TRUE damage proportional to the target's maximum HP. Requested amount = ceil(fraction x target.maxHP x (2 + AP/100)) with fraction 10 % / 15 % / 25 % / 35 % by the caster's stars (fallback 35 %); the AP is already inside this formula and handleSpecialDamage is called with apBoost = false, so it is not applied twice. The cast crit flag is passed on (crit only with ABILITY_CRIT). TRUE damage skips the defense division but still passes the ceil and floor-of-1 step in handleDamage; shields absorb first. The return value is not used.

targeting.note: requiresTarget keeps the base default true, so the caster walks to range before casting.

effects.scaling: requested = ceil(fraction x target maxHP x (2 + AP/100)); with AP 0 that is twice the fraction of max HP (20 % for 1 star, 30 % for 2 stars). downstream request into handleDamage: handleSpecialDamage adds no AP (apBoost false), doubles it if the caster has DOUBLE_DAMAGE (consumed), multiplies by 1.2 with the strange-steam board effect, and on a crit by 1 + (critPower - 1) x critReductionFactor (Rocky Helmet and Black Augurite do not reduce crits for TRUE damage; the crit counts for the target only when no negation applies). handleDamage then applies no defense division to TRUE damage, but the ceil and floor of 1 still apply (core-mechanics section A), and a shield absorbs first; the shield part counts in the returned takenDamage (section J1), which this ability discards. Protect, skydiving or magic bounce on the target return takenDamage 0; a magic bounce reflects only SPECIAL type damage, so nothing is reflected here, and a Power Lens only retaliates against SPECIAL type.
effects.resolution: requested ceil(fraction x maxHP x (2 + AP/100)) -> downstream request after DOUBLE_DAMAGE / crit factors -> final HP loss after shield absorption, Protect, and the section J1 exceptions (Shiny Charm, Fossil, Cover Band); the strategy uses none of the returned amounts

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3- and 4-star values (25 %, 35 %) are not reachable at the factory star counts of these units. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Stateless; each cast recomputes from the target's current maxHP. No stored mode.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: fraction x target maxHP x (2 + AP/100) rounded up (20 % / 30 % of max HP at AP 0 for Bidoof / Bibarel). Downstream: no second AP, crit factor only if the cast crits (ABILITY_CRIT), DOUBLE_DAMAGE x2. Final: no defense reduction, ceil and floor of 1, shield first, then HP; blocked by Protect or skydiving. The base is the target's maximum HP, not its current HP.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: The full handleDamage chain for TRUE damage (section A lists the defense step and the ceil/min-1 step; weather, fields, resurrect and death rules were not traced)
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
unresolved: Whether other effects change the target's maxHP before the cast (the formula reads maxHP at the moment of the cast)
Whether Bidoof/Bibarel ever reach a different star count than the factory value
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
